findings.title: FilterShell fix has duplicate, conflicting gap classes
findings.location: Design section 2b, Fix 1 — Sort/count row overflow
findings.problem: The proposed class string contains both gap-2 and gap-4 at the base (non-responsive) level. This creates a conflict where the applied gap value on mobile is non-deterministic.
findings.fix: Remove gap-4 from base classes. Use gap-2 for mobile and sm:gap-4 for desktop: "flex flex-col gap-2 border-b border-neutral-800 pb-4 text-sm text-neutral-400 sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:gap-4"

findings.title: use-server.md cited under a non-existent path
findings.problem: The design cites 'node_modules/next/dist/docs/use-server.md' which does not exist. The actual file is at 'node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-server.md'. AGENTS.md requires consulting in-repo docs before writing code; a wrong path causes implementers to skip or fail this check.
findings.fix: Replace the path reference with the correct one: node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-server.md

findings.title: Dead signOut import left in layout.js after MobileNav refactor
findings.location: Design section 2a, Layout changes in src/app/layout.js
findings.problem: layout.js currently imports signOut from @/app/actions. After the refactor, MobileNav owns all sign-out forms and imports signOut directly, making the layout.js import unused. The design's change table does not mention removing it, risking a build failure if unused-import linting is enabled.
findings.fix: Add to the layout.js change instructions: 'Remove import { signOut } from "@/app/actions" from layout.js; that import moves to MobileNav.jsx.'

findings.title: FeaturedDishCard uses group-hover:text-amber-400 but convention is group-hover:text-amber-300
findings.problem: The existing DishCard.jsx uses group-hover:text-amber-300 for dish name hover. FeaturedDishCard uses group-hover:text-amber-400. Both resolve to #15803d today (amber-300 === amber-400), so it is visually identical but inconsistent with the established codebase pattern.
findings.fix: Change to group-hover:text-amber-300 to match DishCard.jsx convention.

findings.title: Hamburger tap-target math formula is incorrect
findings.problem: The formula '2.5 × 4 × 4 = 40 px padding' is wrong. The correct calculation is: p-2.5 = 2.5 × 4px = 10px per side; 10 × 2 + 24px icon = 44px total.
findings.fix: Replace comment with: 'p-2.5 = 2.5 × 4 px = 10 px padding per side; 24 px icon + 2 × 10 px = 44 px total tap area'

findings.title: layout.js keeps getSession — this is correct but unstated
findings.problem: The design does not explicitly state that layout.js must retain the getSession() call to fetch session server-side before passing it as a prop to the client component MobileNav. This is correct behavior but the reasoning is not captured, which may cause an implementer to incorrectly move session fetching into MobileNav.
findings.fix: Add a comment clarifying: 'layout.js keeps getSession() — session is fetched server-side and passed as a plain serializable prop to <MobileNav session={session} />. MobileNav cannot call getSession() directly because it is a Client Component.'
